Specifically, the rule `more_toppings_cost_more.yaml` uses `extract_float(conv[0].price)` and `extract_float(conv[1].price)` to compare prices based on the number of toppings.

3. **Check Other Rules:**
   If there are any other rules that reference `price`, make sure to update those as well.
